publication.name: Known Route
publication.positioning: Calm, source-first digital safety for people who do not work in cybersecurity.
publication.audience: English-speaking adults who use banking, shopping, messaging, email, and social media online.
publication.readerPromise: Every article explains the risk in plain language, gives a short action plan, cites primary sources, and shows when it was last checked.
antiPositioning: No unsupported claims or anonymous-source reporting

editorial.cadence: Two substantial posts per week, plus urgent corrections when evidence changes.

growth.primaryChannel: Search discovery from specific, high-intent questions.
growth.northStar: Returning readers who reach an actionable guide from search or a direct visit.
growth.nextMilestone: Publish a coherent 12-article launch library across the three editorial pillars.

decisionRules: Prefer evergreen questions with a recurring need over transient news unless delay could harm readers.
Do not publish from model memory; factual claims need retrievable source URLs.
If a post cannot offer a clear action, merge it into a stronger guide or abandon it.
If evidence conflicts, say so and narrow the claim.
Update or retire stale posts before increasing cadence.
Do not change positioning from fewer than four weeks of evidence unless there is a safety or factual problem.
